A.why: An honest blue-coated soldier with a cream baldric, but from above the brown hat crown reads as leather and nothing in the outline is uniquely Fortwarden.
A.fix: Turn the hat into a steel or blue kettle hat with a broader brim and a brass badge on the band, and make that the set's signature.

B.why: The grey visored cap and big grey slab pauldrons dominate the top-down view and read as the iron family, with blue only as a chest strip.
B.fix: Recolour or shrink the slab pauldrons so the town blue reads from above, and give the flat grey helm a heraldic shape.

C.why: The crenellated tower helm is the boldest idea, but the figure is charcoal and grey with blue only on the pauldron caps, so it reads as iron.
C.fix: Make the coat blue, put cream on larger crenels and add a brass helm badge, keeping steel only for the helm and pauldrons.

D.why: The quartered tabard and the cream cross on a blue cap give the clearest heraldic read from the ARPG camera, but the pale pauldrons glare and the cream reads as khaki.
D.fix: Darken and narrow the pauldrons and warm the cream quarters so the blue-and-cream arms lead.

E.why: The most thoroughly town-blue set, with a fine back-pavise garrison idea, but the pavise frame wraps the torso in profile and the dome coif reads as soft.
E.fix: Flatten the pavise onto the back with a blue field and a cream charge, and give the coif a steel brow or a brass-bossed nasal.

F.why: The crested steel helm, the blue coat, the cream-edged pauldrons and a big brass chest roundel make it heraldic, sturdy and muted, with one clear silhouette idea.
F.fix: Reshape the bent-block crest into a thinner segmented fore-and-aft crest in blue and cream so it reads from above and doesn't look like a finger.

notes: All six use town blue and hold on the slim avatar. The field splits on how much grey steel they show from above: B and C drift into iron, while D, E and F keep blue and cream dominant. F has the best single silhouette and brass badge, D the best top-down heraldry (the cross on the cap), and E the best colour family but a clumsy pavise fit. Judged from the PNG renders only.
